implementation_language: C99 with GCC/Clang unsigned 128-bit integer extension for exact recognition intervals

implemented_routines.name: format_numeric_result
implemented_routines.scope: ordinary real decimal, tagged rational and integral-component surd output, numeric conversions, recurring decimals, DMS, engineering and finite-decimal prime factors in supplied COMP contexts0..6; exact coefficient grouping and numeric context reset for complex/polar components; current/previous selections represented; modal paths excluded

implemented_routines.name: format_exact_numeric_result
implemented_routines.scope: rational/mixed/linear serialization, integral-component surds, ordinary fraction and pi selection

implemented_routines.name: format_normal_decimal
implemented_routines.scope: Norm1/Norm2, fixed-point width, scientific fallback, compact contexts

implemented_routines.name: format_fixed_decimal
implemented_routines.scope: Fix 0..9 with decimal rounding and magnitude fallback

implemented_routines.name: format_scientific_decimal
implemented_routines.scope: Sci 1..10 with packed superscript exponent tokens

implemented_routines.name: format_sexagesimal
implemented_routines.scope: selection1 and marked decimals at selection0/13; decimal minute/second arithmetic, cleanup, centisecond rounding, width limits and numeric fallback

implemented_routines.name: format_recurring_decimal
implemented_routines.scope: bounded integer long division and remainder-cycle detection, exact and recognized rationals, terminating/oversized-period numeric fallback

implemented_routines.name: format_prime_factors
implemented_routines.scope: canonical unmarked decimal records with exponent-99..99, prime powers, fractional quotient termination and signed parenthesized remaining factor

implemented_routines.name: bounded_prime_factorization
implemented_routines.scope: trial division by the 168 primes through997 using the original finite-decimal quotient/remainder behavior

implemented_routines.name: recognize_ordinary_fraction
implemented_routines.scope: bounded continued-fraction interval recognition, decimal exponent -8..6 and original display digit budget; finite differential verification

implemented_routines.name: cleanup_and_test_integer
implemented_routines.scope: last-BCD-pair probe for rational and pi recognition; exponent-dependent mantissa boundaries

implemented_routines.name: recognize_pi_coefficient
implemented_routines.scope: firmware pi division, scale25200, integer cleanup and gcd reduction for unmarked decimal records

implemented_routines.name: adjust_engineering_exponent
implemented_routines.scope: selections2..9, current/previous selection cycling, zero handling and single-step exponent bounds

implemented_routines.name: engineering_normal_width
implemented_routines.scope: Norm1/Norm2 significant-position budget after engineering exponent placement

implemented_routines.name: engineering_fix_scientific_width
implemented_routines.scope: Fix/Sci rounding, digit budgets and zero trimming including compact contexts1..3 and restored full width for contexts4..6

implemented_routines.name: append_exponent_tokens
implemented_routines.scope: engineering quotient/remainder superscript tokens, including boundary exponents above99
